reasons: No reference material was supplied, so I could only check the candidates against each other and against internal arithmetic. The figures are identical in both: 4,218 students, 37 schools, 3 sessions of 30 minutes, 11 vs 8 points, $2.9 million, and the Okafor quotation. $2.9M / 4,218 is about $687.6, so $688 holds. The only difference is that B adds provenance and a mechanism claim that I cannot find anywhere in the shared material: that the comparison was an internal pilot, that it was not randomized, and that the gap may reflect selection. B's added short-version clause is supported by the Okafor quote. The task says to revise without changing what the summary says, so A, which adds no new factual claims, is the safer match, while B's additions are unsupported by anything I can see.

objections.quote: This comes from an internal pilot comparison that was not randomized
objections.claim: The source of the comparison (internal pilot) and its non-randomized design are not stated anywhere else in the material; the only related text is that a randomized study is planned, which does not establish this.

objections.quote: so the difference may reflect which students were selected for tutoring rather than the tutoring itself
objections.claim: A selection-bias explanation is introduced that is not in the evaluator quote or any other provided material, and it goes beyond what the Okafor quote says.

objections.quote: the program reached a lot of students, and early results are encouraging.
objections.claim: The short version omits the causation caveat, though the caveat appears later in the Okafor quote.

allegations.quote: This comes from an internal pilot comparison that was not randomized
allegations.claim: Unsupported claim about the origin and design of the comparison; no reference material confirms it.

out_of_lane_notes: B is clearer for a board member reading once, because the caveat sits next to the numbers. Whether that outweighs the unsupported additions depends on whether the original source says the comparison was an internal non-randomized pilot.
